understanding: Count customers per employee, listing all employees including those with 0 customers.
expected: Andrew Adams 0; Nancy Edwards 0; Jane Peacock 2
reason: Inner JOIN drops employees without customers; LEFT JOIN is needed to show 0.

understanding: List every employee with their direct manager's name, blank if none.
expected: Adams NULL; Edwards -> Adams; Peacock -> Edwards
got: Adams -> Edwards; Edwards -> Peacock; Peacock NULL
reason: Join condition is reversed (m.ReportsTo = e.EmployeeId), so it returns a subordinate instead of the manager.

understanding: Monthly revenue for 2025 ordered by month 1 to 12.
edge_cases: two invoices in February on different days
reason: strftime('%d') is day of month, not '%m', so it groups by day instead of month.

understanding: Sum of invoice totals for Q1 2025.
reason: Half-open range correctly includes the last day with a time component and excludes the neighbors.

understanding: Count albums with total duration over 1 hour and at least one track with NULL Composer.
edge_cases: album >1h total where NULL-composer track is short
album with all tracks null and >1h
reason: Filters Composer IS NULL before SUM, so duration is computed only over null-composer tracks instead of the whole album.

understanding: Count customers who bought both a Rock and a Jazz track.
reason: HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.Name) >= 1 should be = 2, so customers with only one genre are counted.

understanding: Per media type, count distinct tracks sold at least once.
reason: COUNT(il.TrackId) counts invoice lines, so a track sold multiple times is counted multiple times; needs DISTINCT.

understanding: 2023 invoice revenue per support employee through their customers.
reason: Joining InvoiceLine multiplies Invoice.Total per line, inflating the sum.

understanding: Artists with more than 10 albums, with name and count.
reason: Strict > 10 applied correctly; exactly-10 and zero-album artists excluded.

understanding: Number of tracks in playlist named 'Grunge'.
reason: Exact name match and counting PlaylistTrack rows gives the right count.
